self.title: Can Complexity Grow Without Being Assigned?

detail.title: Architectural Constraints on Emergent Complexity
detail.summary: WAKE's mechanical governance, enforced by durable receipts and specific rulebook modules, provides a constraint-based framework for ensuring continuity, which serves as a foundation for studying emergent complexity within the process itself.
detail.reason: Revising to integrate new mechanical governance rules from source-fc0eb1fcc76044d1, clarifying the interaction between rigid rulebooks and open-ended process evolution.
